items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: The leading global lithium producer Albemarle Corp. (NYSE:ALB) has named BHP Group Limited's (NYSE:BHP) Chief Commercial Officer Ragnar "Rag" Udd as its next CEO. Udd will take over on Feb. 1, 2027, succeeding Kent Masters, who will become executive chairman.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Global lithium demand jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap, with lithium iron phosphate chemistry commanding 99.9% of the storage market.

items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle idled its Kemerton lithium hydroxide processing plant in Australia, citing prolonged price volatility. Market conditions have shown improvement; Energy Storage business reported Q2 2026 results against recovering lithium pricing.

items.headline: Big Charlotte employer taps outsider as new CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle prepares to reopen a dormant 1,200-acre lithium mine outside of Charlotte (Kings Mountain), which recently completed federal permitting. Albemarle reported net sales of $1.7 billion in Q2, up 31% year-over-year.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. Chinese spot lithium prices surged 22% this year so far. Albemarle (ALB) noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Third-quarter adjusted EBITDA expected at $668 million, down from $858 million in Q2. Greenbushes CGP3 plant delayed following a June fire.
